title: The best plan so far, from every solution the solver reports

blocks.text: An operations dashboard shows a long MIP solve's progress as a line: the value of the best plan found so far, after each solution the solver reports. Lesson 4.3.5 showed that SCIP reports *every* feasible solution its heuristics find, worse ones included, so the callback has to keep the best itself.
Write `make_tracker(objective, maximize)`. `objective` is a dict from variable to its objective coefficient; `maximize` says the sense. It returns a pair `(callback, history)`:

items: `callback`, a function for `Event.MIP_SOLUTION`. Given a `mathopt.CallbackData`, it computes the reported solution's objective value $`\sum_v c_v \cdot \text{solution}[v]`$, appends the best value seen so far (the largest when maximizing, the smallest when minimizing) to `history`, and returns an empty `mathopt.CallbackResult()`.

blocks.text: The tests call your callback with hand-made `CallbackData` and also register it on a real SCIP solve. About twelve lines.

from __future__ import annotations

from ortools.math_opt.python import mathopt


def make_tracker(objective: dict, maximize: bool):
    """(callback for MIP_SOLUTION, history of the best objective value after each reported solution)."""
    history: list[float] = []

    def callback(data: mathopt.CallbackData) -> mathopt.CallbackResult:
        value = sum(coef * data.solution.get(v, 0.0) for v, coef in objective.items())
        if history:
            value = max(value, history[-1]) if maximize else min(value, history[-1])
        history.append(value)
        return mathopt.CallbackResult()

    return callback, history


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = mathopt.Model()
    a = model.add_binary_variable(name="a")
    callback, history = make_tracker({a: 3.0}, maximize=True)
    callback(mathopt.CallbackData(event=mathopt.Event.MIP_SOLUTION, solution={a: 1.0}))
    print(history)

cases.says: two improving solutions of a maximization are recorded as their two values, and the callback asks nothing of the solver
on a SCIP solve the history is not empty and reaches the optimum
a solution worse than the best so far records the best again
for a minimization the best so far is the lowest value seen
